reviews.review_title: A Really Fun Take on Weapon Handling
reviews.review_description:
What an intriguing game. The first time I played, I had difficulty figuring things out, which was frustrating at first, but as I continued tinkering around I started to peel back some layers to this game that I didn't think we're possible.

Part of what really draws me to this game is the intricacies of handling a weapon. Ok, you have a melee weapon, but how do you swing it when an opponent is moving towards you with one themselves? How do you handle them when they have a projectile weapon? These are answers that you need to find yourself, and part of that is fun, while also challenging. The game loop is simple, but how you handle our weapons is the important part, which makes this fun. 

Ok, so you've figured out how to swing a sword, now how do you handle a revolver? How to you reload it, how do you c*ck the hammer? How do you time your shots as your opponent approaches? I only tried this weapon once, but it was a musket sort of weapon. I couldn't figure it out, but I soon realized that's what makes this game the most gun. What comes first the gun powder or the miniature cannon ball you're loading into the front of the barrel? Whats this stick (ramrod) that is sitting on the table? How do I use it. As I began to figure things out, I then had to think about my opponent, and what weapon they were using, and how I had to approach my fight. The multi-faceted but simple combat mechanics had me really thinking here. It was super enjoyable! 

All in all, Duel Me Bro is an extremely fun, and quasi-sophisticated game that offers an extremely fun game loop, lots of multiplayer options, and some additional game modes that should have you wanting to play more while you figure out how to handle your weapons.
